Checked the complete switch against the proposed description: signed state cast, threshold ordering, impact clamp, state-2 pre-decrement guard, state-3 threshold, state-4 predicate negation and reset-before-test, restoration operations and default-path x08 clearing all agree. contradictions.reason: Accept the rejection of the .sdata2 Past Stages mapping and all eighteen listed stage/cloud links, plus supersession of the hit/updater game mappings and cloud-based updater name and purpose. Supported existing lifecycle, component, hit, joint-collision and corrected Rotating Block knowledge remains retained; no equivalent rewrites are needed.

Accept supersession of the state-behavior claim: state 4 restores only when the spatial predicate is false, resets its timer before that test, and can remain blocked in state 4. Attack priority, timer thresholds and unconditional transient-accumulator clearing are preserved accurately.
Accept deferral of the writable-section placement claim. The callback array and StageData declarations establish source records, not compiled section membership.

Accept deferral of all four .rodata switch/layout claims. The switch and diagnostic are present, but source does not prove a five-entry jump table, section placement or a 40-byte layout. The diagnostic contains 18 characters plus its terminator, not an inherently 20-byte contribution. Cloud attribution is not supported.

Accept deferral of all three .sdata diagnostic/layout claims. The failure branch and __FILE__ use are established; emitted expansion, section attribution, extent and padding are not. The basename gryorster.c has ten characters, so the prior eleven-character arithmetic cannot justify a compiled extent.

Accept deferral of the three remaining .sdata2 literal-pool claims. Source arithmetic establishes numeric uses but neither generated loads nor complete pool contents, placement or exclusion of other compiler constants.

unresolved: Compiled section placement, jump-table lowering, literal-pool completeness, __FILE__ expansion, string extents and padding remain unverified; the eleven upstream section-related deferrals are accepted.
